description.value: The Creston Museum is a community history museum operated by The Creston & District Historical & Museum Society, dedicated to the unique pioneer, Indigenous, agricultural, and industrial heritage of the Creston Valley at the heart of the Kootenays. It features rotating exhibits on subjects ranging from WWI soldiers to a model railway, alongside archives, photo galleries, and children's programs. For a touring cyclist rolling through the valley between the Purcell and Selkirk ranges, it offers rich local context on the landscape and communities they are riding through.
